rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a remark or action that is unnecessary, meaningless, or unable to achieve its purpose.

example.english: It’s pointless to keep talking; nobody is going to change their mind.
example.traditional: 你再講落去都係無謂，大家唔會改變主意。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 gong2 lok6 heoi3 dou1 hai6 mou4 wai6 daai6 gaa1 m4 wui5 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3

rows.note: Use this specifically when an argument, remark, or discussion lacks a clear main point.

example.english: Your explanation is pointless; I still don’t know what you’re trying to say.
example.traditional: 你講咗咁耐都冇重點，我仲係唔明你想點。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 mou5 zung6 dim2 ngo5 zung6 hai6 m4 ming4 nei5 soeng2 dim2

rows.note: Use this for a physical object whose end is not sharp, such as a sword or knife.

example.english: This knife is pointless; it can’t even cut paper.
example.traditional: 呢把刀太鈍，連張紙都切唔開。
example.jyutping: ne1 baa2 dou1 taai3 deon6 lin4 zoeng1 zi2 dou1 cit3 m4 hoi1
